settings_description: How shoppers pay at checkout. With manual methods, like cash on delivery or a bank transfer, you collect the money yourself and mark the order paid.
settings_no_access_title: Your role can't see payment methods
settings_no_access_description: Ask the store owner for the payments:read scope.
settings_none_enabled_title: Checkout is refused until a payment method is enabled
settings_none_enabled_description: Carts with something to pay can't be checked out. Add a method below, or turn one on.
methods_description: Shoppers see the enabled ones offered in their market and channel, in this order.
methods_empty_description: Add cash on delivery or a bank transfer to start taking orders.
method_dialog_subtitle_edit: Orders already placed keep the name and instructions they were placed with.
method_dialog_subtitle_app: The shopper pays at checkout through {app}, which reports the payment.
method_dialog_subtitle_manual: A manual method: the shopper pays you directly, and you mark the order paid.
method_kind_built_in: {app}, built into the API: the shopper pays at checkout.
method_kind_app: Taken by the {app} app: the shopper pays at checkout.
method_instructions_description: Shown to the shopper after checkout and on their order: bank details, what to pay the courier.
method_markets_description: None chosen: offered in every market.
method_channels_description: None chosen: offered in every channel.
method_delete_description: Shoppers stop seeing it. Orders already paid this way keep its name and instructions.
preset_cash_on_delivery_description: The shopper pays the courier; you mark the order paid.
preset_cash_on_delivery_instructions: Pay the courier in cash when your order arrives.
preset_bank_transfer_description: The shopper transfers the total; you mark the order paid when it lands.
preset_bank_transfer_instructions: Transfer the total to IBAN HR12 3456 7890 1234 5678 9 (Your Store Ltd), with your order number as the reference.
preset_custom_description: Anything else you collect yourself: a card terminal, an invoice.
preset_custom_instructions: What the shopper should do to pay.
